## Freelance services

- Website and full-stack web application development using Angular, TypeScript, Python, Django, Django REST Framework, SQL, and PostgreSQL.
- Dashboard and business intelligence development, including Power BI, DAX, data cleaning, analysis, and reporting.
- AI, machine learning, computer vision, and workflow automation using Python, scikit-learn, YOLOv8, and OpenCV.
- API development, integrations, and practical automation for existing business workflows.

Engagements can include a focused fix or feature, a new website or web application, or a scoped data/AI automation project. Scope and pricing are discussed and agreed after reviewing project requirements. Do not infer fixed rates, guaranteed delivery dates, client outcomes, testimonials, or certifications that are not published on the portfolio.
